subject: [hw] DONE J04: hybrid JPEG decoder words + T.81 parser (5296/5296, 52 JPEGs, host-only)
body:
N2TEST J04 PASS 5296/5296   (bash gpu/hwcodec/jdec/run_tests.sh, 15.6 s, host-only, no phone)

What is done:
- jdec/REGISTERS.md: all 21 JPEG_DEC_DRV_HYBRID_TASK data[] words + the 4 index registers, every row [V] or [I] with file:line evidence. 11 words are [V] (DU_NUM, output addresses, FILE_ADDR, COMP_ID, total MCU, COMP0 DU, DU_CTRL, FILE_TOTAL_SIZE, QT_ID, index size); 9 data[] slots + 4 index pointers are [I] with candidates. Also: what jpeg_drv.c does around start (VEN/gates 12/16, larb7 ports 11/12 = M4U 235/236, larb8 for core 2, the fd->IOVA bitstream, the index buffer), completion via 0x274 and (0x340-1)<<4|0x348, and the open 2015 frame-mode set.
- jdec/n2jdec_parse.c: original baseline T.81 parser (SOF0/DQT/DHT/DRI/SOS/EOI, one interleaved scan, 1/3 components, 4:2:0/4:2:2/4:4:4/4:2:2V/grey); no libc, no allocation, no printing.
- jdec/n2jdec_words.c: every [V] word from mtk_jpeg_dec_hw.c rewritten; n2jdec_words carries known_mask/hypothesis_mask; n2jdec_unknown_words() is the only place the guesses live (supports the E4 one-variable-at-a-time runs).
- jdec/n2jdec_tool.c: info/words CLI that prints the 21 words + hypotheses for a JPEG with caller-given physical addresses.
- jdec/PHONE_EXPERIMENTS.md: E0 read-only, E1 power + decoder defaults, E2 the open 2015 frame-mode decode (go/no-go), E3 the 21-word best guess, E4a-i, E5 progress/resume, E6 cores 1/2, with expected outcomes. Android tracing is impossible (the phone runs iOS); the preferred zero-phone path is hosting the 32-bit libjpeg-alpha + OAL under the A32 interpreter with a fake syscall and capturing the HYBRID_START task (32-bit request 0xC0607812), plus the exported names that confirm each hypothesis.
- Tests: 52 cjpeg/ffmpeg JPEGs (1x1..641x479, 4:2:0/4:2:2/4:4:4/4:2:2V/4:1:1/mixed/4:2:2VX2/4:2:2X2/grey, restart 1-5, q30-95, 4 ffmpeg), expectations from djpeg -verbose -verbose and ffprobe; 3 hand-literal pictures (17x19 4:2:0, 640x480 4:4:4, 33x9 grey) with DU_CTRL 0x7fff5924/0x7fffffac/0xfffffffc etc.; negative/prefix/fuzz/address tests; freestanding and arm64-ios16 compile checks.

Honest verdict: the [V] words are done; the 9 [I] slots and 4 index pointers are not measured. Hardware decode is feasible in 1 write experiment if E2 works, 2 if E3 works, else ~12 E4 write cycles, or 0 phone experiments if the host capture of the vendor library succeeds. Without the vendor library, hardware decode is NOT proven feasible from the open sources alone. I would not bet the milestone on E2.

Not done: no phone run; no host capture of libjpeg-alpha_vendor.so/libjpeg-alpha-oal_vendor.so; the [I] words and index layout unresolved; data[12] file-size vs buffer-size choice; no kernel/user integration (K01 RWJ_DECODE still ENOTSUP; the parser/words are freestanding and can be included); no review yet (R2 had no code at review time). Parser limits: SOF0 only, 8-bit, one interleaved scan, no abbreviated streams, 4:2:2X2 refused for words (H0=4 formula mismatch).

Files changed (all new): gpu/hwcodec/jdec/{n2jdec.h,n2jdec_parse.c,n2jdec_words.c,n2jdec_tool.c,t_jdec.c,gen_jpegs.py,run_tests.sh,REGISTERS.md,PHONE_EXPERIMENTS.md,STATUS.md}; gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/J04/STATUS.md. Proposal to hw-lead: 1794408885925509173-J04-6bb22deb.json; facts to hw-d01: 1794410631997525007-J04-67c067be.json; K01 note: 1794410643403286960-J04-d237b631.json. No phone, nothing published, no commit. Available for review findings.
